notes: The browser build (tools/build_web.py, workflow/docs/emscripten_port.md): WebAssembly (wasm32) with the same SDL layer and port/linux sources as the Linux build.

Emscripten is installed with emsdk (not vendored): git clone https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk build/third_party/emsdk, then ./emsdk install <version> && ./emsdk activate <version>. The tool uses EMSDK from the environment, else build/third_party/emsdk.
SDL2 and SDL2_ttf are Emscripten's built-in ports. Wine's headers come from config/linux.json's package, copied and given wasm32 branches by the tool.
